in_marathi.name: Harendar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Hari's beloved
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is dear to Lord Hari (Vishnu). In Hindu mythology, Hari is a name of God Vishnu, who is revered for protection and preservation. Harendar signifies the deep devotion and dedication towards the divine.
